Know.note: The one good player who learns a Widow is in play.

Poisoned.note: Any player the Widow poisons, possibly the Widow itself.

reminders.label: Know
reminders.text: Choose a good player who will learn a Widow is in play: put [Know] on them
reminders.reason: This good player learns a Widow is in play

reminderMovement.why: The Widow poisons once, on the first night, and one good player learns of her.

reminderPlaceholders.note: The Widow poisons a player; one good player learns a Widow is in play.

full.text: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Widow needs. The Widow chooses a player: mark them *POISONED*. Choose a good player: mark them *KNOW*. Put the Widow to sleep, wake the *KNOW* player and show them the Widow token.
full.reason: Says which token goes on whom, in the order they are placed.
